note: Source ambiguity: the book prints 'a set of n integers a_1, a_2, ..., a_{2k+1}' and then uses a_n; the statement is read with n = 2k+1 (odd). For even n it would be false (e.g. 1, -1, 1, -1 gives 0, 0, 0, 0).
